parameters.name: CrowdSplit-Signature
parameters.description:
HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw request body, signed with the
merchant's webhook secret. Format: `t={unix-ts},v1={hex-hmac}`.

parameters.name: CrowdSplit-Timestamp
parameters.description:
Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) at dispatch. Merchants should
reject the delivery if the skew against their own clock exceeds
5 minutes, to limit replay windows.

parameters.name: CrowdSplit-Notification-Id
parameters.description:
Unique delivery ID. Stable across retries of the same logical event
— use it to deduplicate idempotently on receipt.
